description: This file contains unit test fixture implementations for the SharedMemoryBuffer component, including setup, mapping/unmapping partitions, retrieving data lengths and offsets, clearing data, and accessing buffer pointers, primarily used for testing the SharedMemoryBuffer functionality in the Rialto media server.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SharedMemoryBuffer functionalities, including initialization, mapping, data length retrieval, offset calculation, data clearing, and buffer access.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a SharedMemoryBuffer instance with specified maximum playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum data length for generic audio is returned correctly.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for unsupported playback types returns zero.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum data length for generic video is returned correctly.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that requesting max data length for unsupported playback types returns zero.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxWebAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum data length for web audio is returned correctly.

methods.name: shouldReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the data offset for video media source type is returned as expected.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that requesting data offset for unsupported media source types throws an exception.

methods.name: shouldReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the data offset for audio media source type is returned as expected.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that requesting data offset for unsupported media source types throws an exception.

methods.name: shouldClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing audio data returns success.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearAudioData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing audio data fails when appropriate.

methods.name: shouldClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing video data returns success.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearVideoData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing video data fails when appropriate.

methods.name: shouldGetDataPtr
methods.description: Checks that a valid data pointer is returned for given playback and media source types.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetDataPtr
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when data pointer retrieval fails.

methods.name: shouldGetFd
methods.description: Verifies that the file descriptor for the shared memory buffer is valid.

methods.name: shouldGetSize
methods.description: Verifies that the total size of the shared memory buffer is as expected.

methods.name: shouldGetBuffer
methods.description: Verifies that the buffer pointer is valid.
